body: The US Department of Homeland Security has barred DeepSeek's AI from all civilian federal IT systems, adding to a growing list of US restrictions on Chinese AI tools.

The move lands as DeepSeek pushes outward: it has just opened its search engine to outside developers at a very low per-query price, a bid for global adoption that now runs straight into government security concerns.
dek: Washington tightens restrictions on the Chinese AI lab as it courts developers with cheap search.
title: US bans DeepSeek from civilian government systems
